rv.q: My enthusiasm sank as the disconnect between mirth and tragedy became inescapable; it’s droll to see Ronney bobbing about with a door strapped to her back, but little more than that.
Hysterical, knowingly corny and as frothy as sea foam, Tye Blue’s production has a fantastically brash, devil-may-care spirit and sparkling performances.
...arguably too many of Dion’s honking, identikit anthems even for a 100-minute show
There is nothing subtle about this jukebox musical, and that’s what makes it so glorious.
Camp and chaotic musical burlesque of the movie Titanic that hits all the right notes
Only Drew and her Celine Dion character are really remarkable here, but it’s undeniably a fun way to start 2025.
Quite possibly the most fun you will ever have in a theatre...Titanique is magnifique!
This is theatre purely for those who want to laugh and be entertained.
For those willing to embrace its chaos and nostalgic charm, it’s an irresistible treat.
You look at your ticket and marvel that it did indeed cost just shy of £100 and long for a little of the MT orthodoxy
